_comment: Ship tuning (flight_core::ShipTuning). Spike test values, not designed. Every field required. forward_speed_curve: (terrain clearance m, forward speed m/s). ramp_curve: (ramp progress 0..1, deflection cap), the ramp times are seconds to full deflection. decouple_time: seconds the switch to decoupled (C) blends over. boost_capacitor (#90): drain_time s full to empty while boosting (0 = no capacitor, boost always there as decided in #24), recharge_time s empty to full after recharge_delay s without boost, start_charge needed to start a boost (a running one lasts until empty), strength_curve: (charge, share of the full boost). TODO(initiator): capacitor or speed stage by default, all times, weaken (linear curve) or cut off (flat curve), see issue #90. landing_slope_limit (#92): degrees; a ship that touches down on ground at most this steep keeps its spot until thrust (any input but down), on steeper ground it is not held.
